verdict.rationale: Manufact's publish checklist audits your own server and offers suggestions: a generated fix prompt for a coding agent, or a built-in autofix flow. Checks also run live in ChatGPT and Claude. This is narrow, product-owned suggestion support, but the docs never say the findings are AI-generated insights from your data, and nothing applies AI analysis to observability or logs. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated insights over user data such as observability events and logs, documentation that the audit suggestions and autofix are AI-produced, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
